Design & checks

The existing internal-gear arrangement now has a module-1 192T ring and solid 12T pinion, giving 16:1 instead of 6:1. Ring diameter increases from 176 to 224 mm. A 688ZZ bearing supports the pinion close to the teeth.

The 15 mm base, 8 mm deck, wider nine-point support mount, deeper 42 mm Z frame and braced stand target structural flex. The support keeps its flat outer print face and 31 mm actuator grid. This tab uses the 4× Z actuator and 1× radial actuator; the original assembly remains available.

At 250 mm reach, a 1.8° motor with 1/16 microstepping commands about 0.031 mm per increment (previously 0.082 mm). This is nominal resolution, not measured accuracy. Backlash, ring runout and vibration need a printed test. No soft isolators are added between the probe and its base.

The explosion separates service modules, with actuator internals and the ring/deck/support kept together. Rotation returns to zero while exploded. Press fits and released threads are documented exceptions to rigid interference checks.
